tasks.short: Design the system and draw it

steps.what: Open the transportation or hydraulic brief
Keep using computer assisted drawing tools

tasks.design: The transportation or hydraulic brief is opened from {DOCS}. The civil engineer designs the systems and structures and signs the design note. Drawing stays on the computer assisted tools the engineer already uses. Those tools do not generate the design. A brief that is empty is not designed from.
tasks.previous_blocker: The brief and the drawings lived in separate folders.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief is already stored on the project.
tasks.still_hard: The design itself stays with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer chooses the system and draws it.

ambition.what: A design note can be signed before the drawings are treated as the project record.

tasks.altitude: The week is still design. The brief is open before the engineer draws.

reach.task: Build from the signed design note
reach.learn: Which brief the design note cites.

evidence.claim: A stored brief can be opened beside the drawing tools. Designing the systems and structures stays with the civil engineer. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

The source pack names a rule that a safety component for road traffic, water, gas, heating, or electricity is high-risk, and that an automated safety function on machinery comes into scope on a stated date. A solely automated decision about a worker is barred, and a study of presence, behaviour, or performance needs consent where a works council has that right. The signing engineer stays responsible. This work does not score staff and does not set a safety specification. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a transportation or hydraulic brief is stored and ends when the engineer has signed the design note or returned an empty brief.
A brief row has brief id and kind, entered by the project lead. Kind is transportation or hydraulic. The brief text is what a person wrote.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the civil engineer's effort.
A missing figure, price, file id, or criterion id is not invented. The civil engineer does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the brief is too thin to design from.
research_questions: Which design notes were signed, and which briefs were returned as too thin?

already_counted.description: Reading the opened file is already in the civil engineer's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The design note for the transportation or hydraulic system

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the brief is too thin and the engineer stops. High: the brief is open and the engineer still designs and draws. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the design and construction questions
Provide technical advice regarding design to industrial or managerial personnel
Cover construction, program modifications, and structural repairs

tasks.design: Design and construction questions are opened from {DOCS}. The civil engineer provides technical advice regarding design to industrial or managerial personnel, and covers construction, program modifications, and structural repairs. The advice stays spoken. The screen does not answer the question.
tasks.previous_blocker: The questions arrived as separate messages the engineer collected.
tasks.enabler_now: The question list is already on the project.
tasks.still_hard: The advice stays with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer knows the design and says what should change.
tasks.altitude: The week still includes the advice. The question list is open before the conversation.

evidence.claim: A stored question list can be opened. The technical advice stays with the civil engineer. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

unknowns: How often the question needs a site visit before advice.

tasks.short: Analyze the survey and the ground

steps.what: Open survey reports, drawings, and blueprints
Check cited drawing ids against the file
Analyze aerial photography and other topographical or geologic data

tasks.design: Survey reports, drawings, and blueprints are opened from {DOCS}. Cited drawing ids are checked against the file. The civil engineer analyzes aerial photography and other topographical or geologic data and signs the note. The screen does not write a geologic conclusion. A missing drawing id stays blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The survey set was a stack the engineer spread on a table.
tasks.enabler_now: The survey files are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Reading the ground stays with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer interprets the photography and the survey.

ambition.what: A drawing id can be checked before the engineer writes the analysis.

tasks.altitude: The week is still analysis. The survey files are open before the engineer reads them.

reach.learn: Which drawing ids the analysis cites.

evidence.claim: Stored survey files can be opened and cited drawing ids can be checked. The analysis stays with the civil engineer. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

tasks.short: Survey the points that guide construction

steps.what: Open reference points, grades, and elevations
Direct or participate in surveying the installations
Establish the points that guide construction

tasks.design: Reference points, grades, and elevations are opened from {PROJECT}. The civil engineer directs or participates in surveying the installations and establishes the points that guide construction. The screen does not place a point. A control value that is blank is not used.
tasks.previous_blocker: The control list was a field book the engineer copied before the survey.
tasks.enabler_now: The control list is already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The surveying stays on the site with the civil engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The civil engineer sees the ground and sets the point.
tasks.altitude: The week is still surveying. The control list is open before the engineer goes out.

reach.task: Build from the points that were set
reach.learn: Which control list the survey used.

evidence.claim: A stored control list can be opened. Surveying and setting the points stay with the civil engineer. A stored project row can show the file id, the figure id, and the text a person already entered. The civil engineer still decides the specification, the design, and the site work. A blank input stays blank.

A solely automated decision about a worker is barred, and a study of presence, behaviour, or performance needs consent where a works council has that right. The signing engineer stays responsible. This work does not score staff and does not set a safety specification. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a project has reference points, grades, or elevations and ends when the engineer has set the points or marked the survey incomplete.
A control row has control id, kind, and value, entered by the survey lead. Kind is reference point, grade, or elevation. A blank value is not used.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the civil engineer's effort.

role.altitude: The civil engineer still designs, advises, analyzes, and surveys. A brief or a drawing file is open first.
reach: A project lead can see a design note only after the engineer signs it.
The file shows which drawing id was checked.
skills_to_grow: Do not accept a generated drawing as the design.
Do not write a geologic conclusion the survey does not show.
role.ambitious_version: Briefs and drawing files are open before design or analysis. The engineer still designs, advises, analyzes the ground, and surveys.
